title: 36 Hours in Rome
abstract: Rome, a glorious jumble of history and art, changes slowly. But lately, the Eternal City has welcomed some new sparkle.

title: 36 Hours in Rome
abstract: Rachel Donadio, The New York Times's Rome bureau chief, spends a weekend exploring some of the avant-garde cultural and culinary attractions of the ancient capital.

title: 36 Hours in Santa Monica, Calif.
abstract: Residents enjoy cultural institutions, athletic facilities, and stores and restaurants of the highest order.

title: 36 Hours in Asheville, N.C.
abstract: Whether it’s culture, the great outdoors or homegrown food and beer, Asheville takes its pleasures seriously.

title: 36 Hours in Venice
abstract: Despite its enormous annual influx of tourists, Venice is filled with in-the-know restaurants and bars, quiet piazzas and a cool art scene familiar mainly to its residents.
